factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial ratios table shows Market capitalisation for 2025: 2,852,405 and 2024: 2,789,418. Closing price of the share for 2025: 0.634 and 2024: 0.620.

factual_claims.claim: The company remains focused on selling land plots within its 13.2-hectare development project and does not have employees, relying on external services and board remuneration for administrative functions.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report states 'The Company does not have any plan to change or start a new business activity next year and will continue to sell of land plots the Company owns.' Personnel section confirms no employees. Note 9 details board remuneration and related party services.

factual_claims.claim: The debt ratio increased to 2.74% from 1.01%, although the company maintains a low level of interest-bearing debt.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial ratios table shows Debt ratio for 2025: 2.74% and 2024: 1.01%. Cash flow and risk sections note the company has no significant interest-bearing assets/liabilities.

factual_claims.claim: Cash flows from operating activities used 142,945 euros in 2025, contrasting with a positive cash flow of 194,723 euros in 2024, primarily due to the lack of cash inflows from property sales and increased working capital outflows.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Condensed cash flow statement shows Cash flows from operating activities for 12 M 2025: -142,945 and 12 M 2024: 194,723. Note 2, Note 3, and Note 4 detail working capital changes (receivables, payables, inventories) supporting the explanation.
